turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, Aangan Studio.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, I’m Priya. I got your number from a friend — Shruti Joshi. She had her flat done by you in Aundh.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course — thank you for calling. What are you looking to do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We have a 3BHK in Kothrud — Dahanukar Colony. We bought it two years ago and it still looks like the builder flat. We want to redo the whole thing — kitchen, living room, both bedrooms.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That sounds like a complete redesign. How big is the apartment?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: About 1,400 sq ft carpet.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And your timeline?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We’d like to be done by March. We’re in no rush.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect. Are you the owner?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes — myself and my husband. He knows we’re calling and is happy to go ahead.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Lovely. Can I take your number and schedule a consultation?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sure. (gives number)

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, Aangan Studio.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi. I was looking at your work on Instagram. I have a 2BHK in Wakad — can you tell me roughly how much something like that would cost?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our pricing depends on the materials and the scope — the best way to get a clear picture is a consultation with one of our designers, who can walk you through everything. What are you planning to do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Full redesign — modular kitchen, wardrobes, living room, both bedrooms. About 950 sq ft.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good scope. What’s your timeline?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We move in November — so maybe starting design from October?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That works well. Shall I set up a consultation?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, but can you give me a rough ballpark first? Even a range?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I genuinely can’t — it varies quite a bit based on materials. Giving you a number without seeing the site would be misleading. The designer will go through all of that with you — the consultation is free and there’s no obligation.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay, fair enough. Let’s book it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, Aangan Studio.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, I saw your work on LinkedIn. My name is Suresh Patil. I’m in Nashik — would you be able to take on a project here? I want to redo my home office and study.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling. We only work in Pune and PCMC at the moment — we don’t have the vendor network to take on projects outside Pune.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Not even for a smaller project?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Even for a smaller project, our execution depends on our contractors being on-site. I’m sorry we can’t help.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Alright, understood. Thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, Aangan Studio.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi — can someone come and give us some ideas for our living room? We’re not planning to do the full thing right now. Just want suggestions on colours, furniture arrangement, what to change.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We’re a full-service studio — our projects include design and execution together. We don’t do advisory or consultation-only visits. If you’re planning a full redesign with execution, we’d be a great fit.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Oh I see. No, we’re just exploring for now. Maybe later.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course — feel free to call back when you’re ready to go ahead with a full project.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, Aangan Studio.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is Aarti Mehta. Vikram Agarwal asked me to call — he’s a close friend of Nikhil’s.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course, thank you. What are you looking for?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We have a 4BHK in Koregaon Park — about 2,400 sq ft carpet. Complete redesign. New flooring, kitchen, all four bedrooms. We’ve already moved out temporarily.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That’s a significant project. Do you have a timeline?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We want to move back in by February. About 4 months.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That should work well. Would you prefer a site visit for the consultation?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes please — Vikram said your team does that.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Absolutely. Can I check your availability for early next week?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, Aangan Studio.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, I’m calling about a commercial project. We’re a startup — just got our first proper office space in Baner. About 800 sq ft. We need workstations for 20 people, a small cabin, a meeting room, and a break area.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We do commercial fitouts up to about 3,000 sq ft. What’s the state of the space right now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Bare shell — just columns and floor. Nothing else.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Full fitout from scratch. And the timeline?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We want to be operational by December. Our team is working from home currently.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: December is doable. Are you the decision-maker for this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I’m the founder.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect. Let’s set up a consultation.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, Aangan Studio.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello — I want to redo my living room and kitchen before Diwali. Can you take it up?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Diwali is about three weeks away. Our design phase alone takes 3–4 weeks, and execution follows. We couldn’t do justice to a project in that time.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Even just the living room?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Even so — a room redesign with execution takes at least 8–10 weeks from start to finish. We wouldn’t want to rush it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: What if I start after Diwali?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: A November start would work well. Shall I note your details for that?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Let me think and call back.

notes: Missed call. No voicemail. Number associated with Nanded City area (Pune). Call-back attempted following morning at 10:15am — no answer.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, Aangan Studio.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I need to speak to someone right now. My project has been going for three months and my designer hasn’t replied in five days. This is not acceptable.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I’m very sorry. Can I take your name and project details?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sheetal Deshpande. My designer is Aryan. Flat in Viman Nagar — 2BHK. I’ve sent three messages and called twice.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sheetal, I’m getting this to our project team right now. Would you prefer to hold for two minutes, or should I have someone senior call you back within 15 minutes?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Callback. And I want it from Nikhil or a senior person — not just whoever picks up.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Noted. I’ll make sure of that.

notes: Existing project complaint. Escalated to studio head immediately.
header: T09 · Phone · 10 September · 11:32am · 5 min 52 sec — ESCALATE

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, Aangan Studio.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi. I have a 1BHK in Kharadi — about 550 sq ft. I want to do the kitchen and one bedroom. My budget is 1 to 1.5 lakh maximum for everything. Is that possible with you?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I appreciate you sharing that. For a kitchen redesign and a bedroom with full execution — materials, furniture, and contractor work — 1 to 1.5 lakh would be significantly below what a project of that scope would cost with us.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Even for one bedroom?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Even for one room. I wouldn’t want to bring you to a consultation if the numbers don’t align. I’d suggest checking with local contractors who work at that price point.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay, thank you for being straight.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, Aangan Studio.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi — I have a question. I’m in a rented apartment. Can you still take up a project?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It depends on the scope. What are you looking to do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It’s a 2BHK in Baner. I’ve been here a year, I have a 3-year lease, and the place is quite bare. I want to properly design the living room, bedroom, and kitchen — no structural changes, just design and fittings.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That’s fine — we’ve done rented apartments before. For the kitchen we’d do a modular unit that can come out cleanly. The rest is largely flooring, lighting, and furniture — all reversible. Have you checked with your landlord?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes — they’re fine with it as long as we don’t break walls.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect. No wall-breaking from us. Shall we set up a consultation?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes please.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, Aangan Studio.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I’m calling about a villa project in Kalyani Nagar. My name is Anand Sharma. The property is about 5,500 sq ft — ground plus two floors. Full end-to-end design.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That’s a significant project. Is this a new property or an existing home?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: New construction. Possession was last month. Completely empty.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And your timeline?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: March next year to move in. No rush.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good time to start. Would you like our principal designer to come to site for the first consultation?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes — this week or next if possible.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me check the calendar and revert by end of day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, Aangan Studio.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi — I want to redo my flat in Aundh. 3BHK, about 1,100 sq ft. What might it cost?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our pricing depends on the materials and scope — the designers go through that at the consultation. What are you planning?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Kitchen, wardrobes in both bedrooms, living room. But seriously — can’t you give me even a rough range? I just want to know if we’re in the same ballpark.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I really can’t give a number that would mean anything without seeing the site and the spec. The difference between a standard and a premium kitchen alone can be 3× the cost. The consultation is free — the designer will give you a proper number by the end of it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Fine. Let’s book then.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect. What days work for you?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, Aangan Studio.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi — I wanted to inquire about an interior project for my parents. They have a 3BHK in Hadapsar — new possession. They want a proper design.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That sounds good. Will your parents be involved in the decision?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes — I’m doing the initial checking. They don’t really use phones much. I’ll tell them about the consultation and they’ll decide.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure — just so we know: your parents would be at the consultation, right? Our designers like to understand the brief directly from the people who’ll live in the space.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, they would come. I’m just calling to see if it’s worth pursuing.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Absolutely. Should I note your details and explain what the consultation involves?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please. (gives number)

notes: Caller is son. Owners are parents; both will attend consultation. Decision with parents.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, Aangan Studio.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, I’m Smita. I’m getting possession of my flat in Undri in about six weeks. 2BHK, 875 sq ft. I want to start the design right away.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Six weeks is just enough lead time to get the design finalised before execution begins. What are you planning?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Full home — kitchen, wardrobes, living room. The full package.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good scope. Are you the owner?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes — my husband and I. He said to go ahead and book the consultation.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can we see the site in its current state, or do you need to wait for possession?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We can go now — the builder will let us in.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Even better. Let me get a designer’s availability.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, Aangan Studio.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi — I’d called on Monday about a project. Someone said they’d get back to me. It’s been two days.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I’m very sorry. Can I get your name?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Girish Nair. I called Monday afternoon. I told someone about my 3BHK in Viman Nagar and gave my number.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I apologise — I don’t see a note. Can you give me your details again? I’ll book the consultation directly now so it doesn’t slip again.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is not a good sign if you forget before you even start.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You’re absolutely right, and I’m sorry. Let me make this right now.

notes: Enquiry originally received Monday — no follow-up. Re-logged Friday. Caller frustrated. Handle with care.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, Aangan Studio.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, I wanted to inquire about — (line drops)

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, Aangan Studio.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi — I called just now and got cut off. I’m Ritu Kapoor from Pimple Saudagar. 3BHK, about 1,050 sq ft. We’ve been here two years but never properly did the interiors. We want to start now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling back. Pimple Saudagar is in our service area. What are you looking to do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Kitchen, wardrobes, living room. We moved in with builder furniture and it’s very basic.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Standard full-home scope. Timeline?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ideally done by March. Plenty of time.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect. Let me book a consultation.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, Aangan Studio.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi — I run a small coworking space. I have a 180 sq ft pod I want to make look really nice. Good lighting, a nice desk, some storage. Can you help?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our commercial projects are typically 500 sq ft or more. A 180 sq ft pod is below our minimum scope.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Not even for a smaller fee?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It’s not about the fee — it’s that our design and execution team is set up for a certain scale. A 180 sq ft space isn’t one we could do well at the quality we’d want to promise. I’d suggest a local designer who specialises in smaller commercial spaces.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Fair enough. Thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, Aangan Studio.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi — I’m planning to open a restaurant in Koregaon Park. I’ve seen your work and I love it. Would you be able to design the interiors?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We appreciate you reaching out. Restaurant and hospitality interiors are outside our current scope — we focus on residential and office spaces. For a restaurant you’d need a studio that specialises in commercial hospitality, which has very different material and compliance requirements.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do you know anyone you could refer?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I don’t have a specific referral I could make confidently, but searching for hospitality interior designers in Pune would give you more relevant options.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Alright, thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, Aangan Studio.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning. I’m Pooja. I have a 2BHK in Magarpatta — Cybercity area. We’ve been wanting to properly design the interiors for a while. Kitchen, both bedrooms, living room. About 900 sq ft.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good scope for us. How soon are you looking to start?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We’re flexible — a January start for execution would be ideal.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That works well. Are you the owner?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes — my husband and I. We both want to be at the consultation.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Excellent. Can I book that now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please.
